notes: Authoritative record spec for the Orc state-enum-gated race. GATE TYPE = state-enum-gated (R7): rewards gate on PDV_State_OrcLifeMode (City=0 | Stronghold=1 | LegionExile=2) plus Malacath piety tier WITHIN the active life mode; exactly one life-mode lane is active at a time and the focused reward family is offer-like for that mode. MALACATH IS THE ONE RELIGIOUS SPINE (R5): Orc depth comes from life-mode expression, not side gods or deity shopping. The 'focus' is the LIFE MODE itself (R3 maps the focused 3-tier set onto life mode rather than onto separate patrons), so all three life-mode families resolve under Malacath. PROGRESSION CURRENCY = Malacath faucet via life-mode-appropriate acts (quality forge / city dignity-and-quality-labor / Legion service); state pace per PDV_Phase20OrcImplementationCosting.manifest.json (mode ceiling rate multipliers LOCKED in ProcessDawn pre-clamp: Stronghold x1.00, City x0.75, LegionExile x0.60 of base; thresholds 25/50/85 identical across modes; calendars Stronghold 8/15/26, City 10/20/34, LegionExile 13/25/43). EQUAL FELT VALUE across modes: City and LegionExile are complete devotional lives, NOT failed Strongholds -- the slower calendar reflects sparser real-world hooks, but the terminal magnitudes per tier are equalized. Broad worship is a STATE on PATRON_STATE_BROAD (R1), NOT a deity -- there is NO PDV_Deity_BroadMalacath aggregate. Broad Malacath T1 fills the FIXED manager property PDV_Bless_Orc_Malacath_T1 (R2); broad Malacath T2 is the new PDV_Bless_Orc_Malacath_T2, capped at Faithful and SUPPRESSED when a life-mode focused family is active (broad < focused, R8). Orc OWNS two new deity records (R4/R5): PDV_Deity_Malacath (create:true, Stance_Orc NATIVE) is the spine; PDV_Deity_Trinimac (create:true, shared with Altmer -- Stance_Orc + Stance_Altmer added) is RARE ideological pressure, not a steady reward lane and grants no always-on boon family. No other new deities. Community standing stays LIGHT and must NOT become a strong second persistent substrate (R8 / budget ledger). Forge rewards REQUIRE quality/value/context/commission (no raw craft-count loop); Legion/Exile service REQUIRES pressure-bearing completion (no faction-membership trigger). T3 recognition = V1 Survey/status text only (Blood-Kin / city-fidelity / exile-return voiced topics are V2). Player-facing text is ASCII-only and uses Skyrim ActorValue names. No magnitude exceeds ~12%.

stateSurfaces.rule: Exactly one active life-mode lane modifies scoring and focused-family eligibility at a time. Mode switches resolve through world evidence (Blood-Kin / pro-stronghold crisis for Stronghold; completed pressure-bearing service for LegionExile; City as fallback) then soft-lock briefly (three-day soft-switch lockout). MCM-only mode choice without world confirmation is REJECTED. Reuses the skeleton scaffold records already present in the framework ESP (record-wired per the costing manifest); this spec does NOT recreate the state track or global mirror.
stateSurfaces.designNote: City/LegionExile slower calendars are pace, not value: each life mode reaches the SAME per-tier terminal magnitudes (equal felt value). Do not let City/LegionExile read as failed-Stronghold.

deityQuests.role: The one Orc religious spine. Broad Malacath worship + all three life-mode focused families resolve under this record. Thresholds use script defaults (25/50/85).

neglect.playerFacingText: You have not kept Malacath's code. Your guard feels thin; your armor rating drops by 5 until you return to worthy work, service, or kin.
neglect.designNote: GENTLE drift neglect (single small negative), distinct from creed-violation loss. Bite is reserved for code-rupture / curse posture (see creedViolationLoss). Neglect fires only after sustained absence of any life-mode-appropriate act (quality forge / city quality-labor or dignity / Legion service), not from a single missed day. Removed on return to worthy work. One neglect spell only (no per-life-mode neglect).

creedViolationLoss.policy: Medium/major only (dishonor under Malacath's code); 2-3 negative deltas. Distinct from gentle neglect drift. Curse-code rupture (werewolf/vampire) is curse posture, judged separately; werewolf can be judged by the code, vampire stays outside the test until cured.

entries.trigger: Code violation against kin or sworn service: betraying Blood-Kin, deserting pressure-bearing service mid-obligation, or selling out a stronghold/dependent. Concrete quest surface only.

entries.trigger: Curse-code rupture: werewolf onset judged against the code (Hircine's beast over the Orsimer code). Vampire onset is grief/exile posture handled by curse-state copy, not this delta, until cured.

The Orc Survey reports the active life mode (City / Stronghold / LegionExile), Malacath standing within mode, last accepted proof reason (quality labor / kin crisis / service / dignity / self-made community), broad-vs-focused state, and curse-code posture (werewolf judged / vampire exile-until-cured) in race language. Required content rows per the costing manifest: PDV_Msg_Orc_Survey_{Stronghold,City,LegionExile}; PDV_Notif_Orc_LifeMode_*_Entry; PDV_Msg_Orc_Malacath_ChampionEntry_{Stronghold,City,LegionExile}; PDV_Msg_Orc_CurseState_{WerewolfOnset,VampireOnset,VampireCured}. budget: Two always-on families only (R8): broad Malacath lane (Layer 1, capped at T2/Faithful) + ONE active life-mode focused family (Layer 2, T1/T2/T3) for the current PDV_State_OrcLifeMode. Broad stays softer than focused and is suppressed under an active focus. Community standing is LIGHT life-mode standing, NOT a second persistent substrate. Trinimac is rare ideological pressure, NOT a third boon family. Reward ceiling ~12% per tier (no magnitude exceeds 12.0): Stronghold steadier, City/LegionExile sharper situational, all three EQUAL felt value. Matches the PDV_RaceRewardBudgetLedger Orc ceiling: 'One active life-mode lane; Stronghold steadier, City and Legion/Exile sharper, no second substrate.'

rulingsCompliance.R1: Broad Malacath is a STATE on PATRON_STATE_BROAD, not a deity. No PDV_Deity_BroadMalacath aggregate. Broad reward via GetFirstTierRaceRewardSpellForOrigin path.
rulingsCompliance.R2: Broad T1 uses the FIXED editorId PDV_Bless_Orc_Malacath_T1 (not recreated); broad T2 follows the stem as PDV_Bless_Orc_Malacath_T2 (new).
rulingsCompliance.R3: Focused 3-tier sets follow PDV_Bless_Orc_<Focus>_T1/T2/T3, with the FOCUS mapped onto LIFE MODE (Stronghold/City/LegionExile) per the Orc brief (life mode is the focus). Grant logic mirrors SyncKhajiitEmphasisRewards/Family (one active focus = one active life mode at a time; T1>=Seeker/T2>=Devoted/T3>=Champion).
rulingsCompliance.R4: PDV_Deity_Trinimac is a SHARED record: Orc owns it (create:true) and authors first; Altmer reuses (create:false) and adds Stance_Altmer. Idempotent, serial authoring keeps PDV_FLST_AllDeities bounded.
rulingsCompliance.R5: Only focusable patrons get deity records. Orc creates Malacath (focusable spine) and Trinimac (focusable pressure record). No pantheon-flavor or side-god records; Aedra/Daedra-beside-Malacath rejected.
rulingsCompliance.R6: No new Daedric Prince records here. Malacath is authored as the native Orc spine (an Aedric-track-equivalent native reward spine). Werewolf/Hircine curse pressure routes through curse posture / the Daedric system, not a new record.
rulingsCompliance.R7: Gate shape = state-enum-gated: rewards gate on PDV_State_OrcLifeMode + Malacath tier within the active mode, treated offer-like for the focused life-mode family with the state enum as the eligibility filter.
rulingsCompliance.R8: <=2 always-on families (broad Malacath + one active life-mode family); broad < focused (broad capped at T2/Faithful and suppressed under focus); community standing NOT a strong second substrate; Trinimac not a third family; one anti-farm mechanism per act (quality/context + daily multiplier for forge; one-shot markers for service; no act gets both ScoreRepeatableAction and 0.7^n); per-tier magnitude ceiling ~12% (max 12.0); creed-violation loss medium/major only (2-3 deltas); ASCII player text; Skyrim ActorValue names only; deityIndex next-available.

judgmentCalls: R3 focus mapping: the Orc brief makes LIFE MODE the focus (not separate patrons), so the three Khajiit-style focused 3-tier sets are keyed Stronghold/City/LegionExile, all resolving under Malacath. This honors 'Malacath is the ONE religious spine' while still giving R3's three-tier focused structure.

Equal felt value vs. locked pace multipliers: the costing manifest LOCKS slower City (x0.75) and LegionExile (x0.60) dawn rate multipliers and longer calendars. I read this as PACE (time-to-tier), not VALUE -- so terminal per-tier magnitudes are equalized across all three modes (City/LegionExile reach the same ceilings, just later), satisfying 'City/Legion must feel complete not failed.'
ActorValue 'Block' uses the project canonical 'Block' spec string; author tools resolve it to the engine Block ActorValue while displayName/playerFacingText say 'Block'.

Magnitude shape mirrors the Nord/Khajiit template (T1 single ~5, T2 two effects ~8/8, T3 three effects topping at 10-12) with distinct AV themes per life mode (Stronghold = Smithing/HeavyArmor/DamageResist; City = Restoration/Speechcraft/Block; LegionExile = OneHanded/Block/StaminaRateMult). All <=12.0, none exceeding the ~12% ceiling, and roughly equal aggregate felt value per tier across modes.

Trinimac carries NO reward family in V1 (rare ideological pressure per the brief and roster). It is created and wired as a focusable/pressure record so Altmer can reconcile it and future content can use it, but it grants no always-on boon -- keeping the family count at 2.

Neglect is a single gentle DamageResist -5 (code-keeping is the Orc identity stat), distinct from creed loss; it bites only after sustained absence of life-mode-appropriate acts, with curse-code rupture handled in creedViolationLoss, matching 'gentle; bite at code-rupture/curse.'

Broad Malacath uses DamageResist (T1) then DamageResist+HealRateMult (T2) -- code-keeping resilience that holds in any life mode and is intentionally softer than every focused-family T2, so suppression-under-focus is a real downgrade-to-upgrade, not a sidegrade.
